correctness.rationale: Spectral Jacobi block decomposition covers all dimensions, leaf transitivity guarantees a nonzero leaf projection in every eigenvalue, and restrictions on b>=3 child branches prove exact per-eigenvalue rank one or two. Invariant semigroup decay proves rate-independent eventual capture. Explicit modular checker independently confirms representative ranks and disproves extension to b=2; the proof, not finite tests, covers all b>=3 and L>=1.
